groups.saying_opens: ما أحب أن أصبح محرما أنضخ طيبا
أنا طيبت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

notes: Two sayings: Ibn Umar's answer (saying 1) and Aisha's (saying 2). Saying 2 has its own act: the narrator entered Aisha's place and reported to her (rule 4a), so it writes the shared head again and ends at her second mention, «فقالت عائشة».
The editor's «- قال سعيد حدثنا أبو عوانة، -» is left out.
